recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published non-substantive clarification in an active build source file while leaving valid role/code terminology unchanged.
issue_request: FHIR-17314 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request raised against STU3 OrganizationRole and applied for R5. It reported PractitionerRole-derived OrganizationRole narrative and element descriptions, and its resolution said remaining role wording such as "Business identifiers that are specific to this role" should be clarified as affiliation wording.
initial_application: Commit 28a52e3312 pre-applied GF#17314 to the old OrganizationRole spreadsheet and replaced many practitioner/role descriptions, but it still left the identifier short/definition using "this role" and the active comment saying the period showed when the role was active. Commit 0b2790895e later renamed OrganizationRole to OrganizationAffiliation, preserving those stale phrases in the successor source.
additional_context: OrganizationAffiliation is active in source/fhir.ini and its StructureDefinition XML is the authoritative current source. Later OrganizationAffiliation work such as FHIR-25406 kept role terminology where it describes the role/code a participating organization plays, so the reconciliation was limited to affiliation-level stale role wording. Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary community evidence.
reconciliation: Updated source/organizationaffiliation/structuredefinition-OrganizationAffiliation.xml so OrganizationAffiliation.identifier says identifiers are specific to this affiliation, and OrganizationAffiliation.active says the period shows when the affiliation was in active use.
source_changes: source/organizationaffiliation/structuredefinition-OrganizationAffiliation.xml: changed OrganizationAffiliation.identifier short and definition from "this role" to "this affiliation".

source/organizationaffiliation/structuredefinition-OrganizationAffiliation.xml: changed OrganizationAffiliation.active comment from "when the role was in active use" to "when the affiliation was in active use".

related_jiras.note: Later OrganizationAffiliation work refined nearby organization and participatingOrganization wording, supporting a narrow fix that preserves intentional role/code terminology.
